author: Lyrical
title: Looking for artist to animate YouTube series intro
content:
Hey all! My friends and I are planning to release a YouTube series in the coming future and we are looking for an artist to animate a 1-minute intro for it. If you are interested, please reach out to me in DM’s, we are willing to pay well! 
#art #artist #artwt #artistoftwitter
